headline: Local Wildlife Strategist Claims Peacocks Are Now Charging Government Consultancies for 'Policy Feedback'
body:
Q: Ramesh, you claim the peacocks at the national residence are now formal policy consultants. How did this transition occur?

A: It started with simple birdseed, but last Tuesday, a particularly majestic blue peacock refused to spread his tail feathers until I drafted a formal Memorandum of Understanding regarding their grain intake. They have since insisted on being addressed as 'Senior Wildlife Liaisons' and have started reviewing the upcoming quarterly budget for bird bath maintenance.

Q: Does the government actually listen to their input?

A: Absolutely. When the Finance Secretary suggested a lower-cost millet blend, the peacocks staged a sit-in on the lawn and refused to pose for any official photography for forty-eight hours. The project was immediately scrapped. They’ve even started demanding ergonomic perches and a faster Wi-Fi connection in the garden to ‘stream their own migration patterns’ in real-time.

Q: Are they taking on other projects outside of the estate?

A: They’ve already been approached by three private urban planning firms to consult on suburban tree canopy density. The peacocks aren't interested in money, of course. They charge exclusively in premium organic sunflower seeds and guaranteed immunity from any lawnmower noise before noon.
caption: Forget lobbyists—the real power players in Delhi have feathers and a very strict demand for premium millet. Governance is about to get a whole lot more ornamental. #WildlifeConsultants #PeacockDiplomacy #NewDelhiLife (satire)
igHook: Would you trust a peacock to manage your office's quarterly budget? 🦚
imagePrompt: A wide, slightly blurred photorealistic shot of a lush garden lawn during a bright morning, with several peacocks standing near a quiet, unoccupied stone bench.
